AI tools can help better predict demand for each product, for example, and help a store reduce waste by more than a third. Other tech can help stores sell food before it expires....

item.title: Does generative AI actually copy artists? Researchers say it’s up for debate
item.description: Researchers from MIT unpack the idea of ‘attribution decay,’ and what it might mean for artists looking to protect their work.
